title: MSME Development Amendment Bill 2026 Mandates TReDS Invoice Routing for CPSUs
summary: Requires all Central PSUs to route MSME supplier invoices through TReDS platforms.

blocks.content: Requires all Central PSUs to route MSME supplier invoices through TReDS platforms.

items: TReDS Mandate: Mandatory TReDS routing for CPSU MSME invoices.
Facilitation Councils: States mandated to establish 3-5 member MSE Facilitation Councils with legal experts.
Appeals Deposit: Buyers challenging MSE awards must deposit at least 50% of awarded amount if pending > 6 months.

blocks.summary: TReDS (Trade Receivables Discounting System) regulated by RBI.

blocks.content: TReDS appeal deposit requirement (min 50% of awarded amount) vs council members (3-5).
